description: What only a desktop can answer. Window control: dragging the title bar, minimising and closing — on Windows and Linux the window is created undecorated, so the app's own caption buttons are the only ones the user has (see buildChrome in apps/web/lib/app.js) — and the window's orientation toggle (`set_orientation`/`get_orientation`), which re-sizes a fixed window a phone does not have. The optimal solver (`optimal_*`): proving a minimum is minutes of every core and ~500 MB of pattern-database generation, and `optimal_prepare` refuses on mobile besides — this capability is the other lock, so a phone's webview cannot even reach the command. A phone injects the identical command surface, which is why the platform list matters. Self-update lives in update.json; it is granted on the same three platforms (macOS self-updates too, since 2026-09-03, alongside its Homebrew cask) and is kept separate because it is a different concern with its own plugins.
